title: Claim
description: A revealed artifact submitted against an objective, with the claims it built on. Revealing requires a prior commitment to H(artifact | submitter | nonce); without one, whoever sees the reveal first could resubmit it as their own.

artifact.description: The thing being verified. Its shape is whatever the objective's verifier expects. Floats are refused at the serialization layer.

nonce.description: Secret until reveal; binds this artifact to this submitter's commitment.

cites.description: Accepted claims this one builds on. Citations point backwards only, which keeps the DAG acyclic and citation-flow attribution terminating.

relations.description: What this claim asserts about earlier claims. Carries no money: attribution, settlement and the frontier all read `cites` and none of them read this. At most one relation per target -- a claim says one thing about any other claim. Omitted entirely when empty, never sent as [].

shares.description: Who is paid for this claim and how much. Carries no money yet: settlement pays `submitter` and this is the encoding landing before the split does. `who` must be a public key and `signature` is that payee's consent over this claim's signing payload, which contains `who` and `weight` for every share but no signature -- so every payee signs the same bytes. Omitted entirely when empty, never sent as []; empty means the submitter takes everything.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over this record with its own `signature` field omitted, hex. Required when `submitter` is 64 lowercase hex characters -- such a submitter IS an ed25519 public key, and a record naming one must prove it holds it. Absent for nickname submitters, which authenticate nothing and never did.
